decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent LED track spotlight that still had its own product page in 2024, it fits our existing lighting and system knowledge well and gives us a strong basis to refine and commercialise it further.

This ceiling luminaire is close to our established offer and its continued standalone presentation in 2024 suggests enough market relevance for us to keep learning from and improving it within our existing capabilities.

Because this flexible LED spotlight is highly related to our current product and application knowledge and was launched only in 2024 with dedicated presentation, we should retain it and use early feedback to optimise it.

The multi-outlet ceiling canopy builds directly on our modular lighting-system competence, so our existing technical and market knowledge should let us absorb feedback quickly and strengthen its commercial performance.

This low-voltage multi-outlet canopy extends capabilities we already possess in lighting systems and installation support, making it a good candidate to keep while we deepen learning and integration into the range.

Although the website signal is weaker because it was only mentioned in 2024, the round glass track luminaires are still closely tied to our design-led track-lighting base, so the cost of continued learning and range completion is likely justified.
